newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ASA INSURANCE HOPES FOR LISTING IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: ASA INSURANCE HOPES FOR LISTING IN JUNE.

text.p: ASA Insurance shareholders approved a share issue of 3.5 million kroons and plans to get a bourse listing by the middle of June, it said on Monday.
ASA will issue 350,000 new shares and it will announce the exact date of the issue in the near future, the company said in a statement after a Saturday shareholder meeting.
The present major shareholders, U.S. investment companies Westfield Finances and Wellfix, exchanged their shares in ASA Kindlustus for AB Kindlustus Group shares.
AB Kindlustus holds 64 percent of ASA Insurance share capital. Some 25 percent of the share capital is owned by Wellfix Ltd and Estonian life-insurer, Blig.
Shareholders also approved a strategy to start analysis of neighbouring markets.
ASA Insurance had turnover of 125 million kroons and a net profit of one million kroons in 1996, compared to 91.9 million kroons and 1.3 million kroons in 1995.
Shareholders decided to pay dividends worth 500,000 kroons and assign the rest to an increase in equity.
The share capital is 25.4 million kroons and equity 32.1 million kroons.
